summary.text: Kevin Allen is the Republican candidate for Colorado State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.
He is an application engineer who earned a bachelor's degree from the Colorado School of Mines in 2009.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Allen was born in Westminster, Colorado.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he holds a degree in metallurgical engineering from the Colorado School of Mines, is a father of three and a sixth-generation Coloradan, and was president of the School of Mines College Republicans for two semesters.
He also said he has testified before redistricting commissions in 2011 and 2021.
Allen was the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 34 in 2022, when Democrat Jenny Willford won the general election with 54.1 percent of the vote to his 43.1 percent.
In the 2022 survey, Allen listed keeping communities safe, keeping communities affordable and keeping education parent-centered as his key campaign messages, and said he supports school choice.
